# MP4Box.js 2.5.0

Unmodified official ES-module distribution files from `mp4box@2.5.0`.
Source: https://github.com/gpac/mp4box.js
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mp4box/-/mp4box-2.5.0.tgz
License: BSD-3-Clause, preserved in LICENSE.

Used only to parse locally selected MOV/MP4 audio-track metadata. Video frames
are never decoded and user media is never uploaded. The application reads AAC
packet ranges directly from the local File object. No CDN requests are needed.
